methods.summary: Combinatorial barcoding of Tn5-tagmented nuclei from flash-frozen tissue, giving single-nucleus chromatin accessibility profiles.

methods.name: snmC-seq
methods.title: Single-cell methylomes identify neuronal subtypes and regulatory elements in mammalian cortex
methods.summary: Single-nucleus methylome sequencing with improved throughput, used to classify neuronal subtypes.

methods.name: snmC-seq2
methods.title: Robust single-cell DNA methylome profiling with snmC-seq2.
methods.summary: Improved single-nucleus methylome library protocol with better read mapping, fewer artifactual reads and higher library complexity than snmC-seq.

methods.name: snmC2T-seq
methods.full_name: Single-nucleus methylcytosine, chromatin accessibility and transcriptome sequencing
methods.title: Single nucleus multi-omics identifies human cortical cell regulatory genome diversity
methods.summary: Single-nucleus joint profiling of DNA methylation, chromatin accessibility and transcriptome from the same nucleus.

methods.name: SNP-SELEX
methods.title: Systematic analysis of binding of transcription factors to noncoding variants
methods.summary: Ultra-high-throughput multiplex protein-DNA binding assay that quantifies transcription factor affinity to tens of thousands of noncoding variants.

methods.name: snRandom-seq
methods.title: High-throughput single nucleus total RNA sequencing of formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded tissues by snRandom-seq
methods.summary: Droplet-based single-nucleus total RNA sequencing that uses random primers so that non-polyadenylated RNA and FFPE-archived material can be profiled.

methods.name: SNuBar-ATAC

methods.summary: Single-oligo transposome barcoding during tagmentation lets scATAC-seq samples be multiplexed without a pre-labelling step.

methods.name: SpaMosaic

methods.name: spASE
methods.title: Detection of allele-specific expression in spatial transcriptomics with spASE
methods.summary: Computational framework for detecting and estimating allele-specific expression in spatial transcriptomics data.

methods.name: SPATAC-seq
methods.title: Mapping the chromatin accessibility landscape of zebrafish embryogenesis at single-cell resolution by SPATAC-seq
methods.summary: Split-pool ligation barcoding of Tn5-tagmented chromatin for single-nucleus ATAC profiling at atlas scale.

methods.name: Spatial Hi-C-RNA
methods.title: Integrative spatial profiling of 3D genome organization and gene expression in tissue
methods.summary: Spatially resolved co-mapping of genome-wide chromatin contacts and transcriptomes from the same tissue section.

methods.name: Spatial Transcriptomics
methods.title: Visualization and analysis of gene expression in tissue sections by spatial transcriptomics
methods.summary: Spatial transcriptomics by reverse-transcribing mRNA from tissue sections on an array of spatially barcoded primers.

methods.name: Spatial-ATAC-Hi-C
methods.title: Spatial chromatin architecture and accessibility co-profiling of mammalian tissues
methods.summary: Microfluidic spatial co-profiling of 3D genome organization (Hi-C contacts) and chromatin accessibility on tissue slides.

methods.name: spatial-ATAC-RNA-seq
methods.title: Spatial epigenome-transcriptome co-profiling of mammalian tissues
methods.summary: Spatially resolved co-profiling of chromatin accessibility and gene expression on one tissue section, using Tn5 tagmentation and in situ reverse transcription with DBiT barcoding.

methods.name: Spatial-ATAC-seq
methods.title: Spatial profiling of chromatin accessibility in mouse and human tissues
methods.summary: Tissue-section chromatin accessibility profiling that combines in situ Tn5 tagmentation with microfluidic deterministic barcoding (DBiT-style).

methods.name: Spatial-CITE-seq
methods.title: High-plex protein and whole transcriptome co-mapping at cellular resolution with spatial CITE-seq
methods.summary: Spatially resolved co-mapping of high-plex surface proteins and the whole transcriptome in tissue, extending CITE-seq to the spatial dimension.

methods.name: Spatial-CUT&Tag
methods.title: Spatial-CUT&Tag: Spatially resolved chromatin modification profiling at the cellular level
methods.summary: Tissue-section profiling of histone modifications by in situ CUT&Tag chemistry with microfluidic deterministic barcoding.

methods.name: Spatial-CUT&Tag-RNA-seq
methods.title: Spatial epigenome-transcriptome co-profiling of mammalian tissues
methods.summary: Spatially resolved co-profiling of histone modifications and gene expression on one tissue section, using in situ CUT&Tag with in situ reverse transcription and DBiT barcoding.

methods.name: spatial-Mux-seq
methods.title: Multiplexed spatial mapping of chromatin features, transcriptome and proteins in tissues
methods.summary: Multimodal spatial profiling of two histone modifications, chromatin accessibility, whole transcriptome and surface proteins on one tissue section.

methods.name: SpatialGlue
methods.title: Deciphering spatial domains from spatial multi-omics with SpatialGlue.
methods.summary: Dual-attention graph neural network that integrates spatial location with each omics layer and then across layers to define spatial domains.

methods.name: SPATNIC
methods.title: SPATNIC enables H&E-grounded cancer-cell identification across spatial and single-cell transcriptomic modalities in colorectal cancer
methods.summary: Variational autoencoder that classifies single cells as cancer or normal from their transcriptomes, trained on pathologist-labelled H&E-matched Xenium cells.

methods.name: Spear-ATAC
methods.title: High-throughput single-cell chromatin accessibility CRISPR screens enable unbiased identification of regulatory networks in cancer
methods.summary: Droplet scATAC-seq modified to also capture sgRNA spacers, so chromatin accessibility can be read out for each CRISPR perturbation.

methods.name: SPIE-seq
methods.full_name: Synthetic perturbation by inserted enhancer sequencing
methods.title: Regulation by partition predicts enhancer target selection in mammalian genomes
methods.summary: piggyBac insertion of enhancers into clonal lines, read out by allele-specific RNA-seq to map enhancer-promoter target choice.

methods.name: spinDrop
methods.title: spinDrop: a droplet microfluidic platform to maximise single-cell sequencing information content
methods.summary: Droplet platform that sorts droplets by fluorescence and uses picoinjection to add lysis and reverse transcription reagents, raising gene detection and cutting background.

methods.name: SPLiT-seq
methods.title: Single-cell profiling of the developing mouse brain and spinal cord with split-pool barcoding
methods.summary: Split-pool ligation barcoding labels RNA from fixed cells or nuclei through successive rounds of barcoding, with no single-cell isolation.

methods.name: spRandom-seq
methods.title: Spatial Total RNA Sequencing of Formalin-Fixed Paraffin-Embedded Tissue by spRandom-seq
methods.summary: Random-primer-based spatial total RNA sequencing that captures complete transcriptomes from FFPE tissue sections.

methods.name: SPRITE
methods.full_name: Split-pool recognition of interactions by tag extension
methods.title: Higher-Order Inter-chromosomal Hubs Shape 3D Genome Organization in the Nucleus
methods.summary: Ligation-free mapping of multi-way interactions by split-pool barcoding of crosslinked complexes.

methods.name: Sprox-seq
methods.title: Spatial proximity sequencing maps developmental dynamics in the germinal center
methods.summary: Spatial proximity sequencing that profiles surface proteins, protein complexes and mRNAs, recording the tissue location of each molecule.

methods.name: Ss-STARR-seq
methods.title: Uncovering the whole genome silencers of human cells via Ss-STARR-seq
methods.summary: STARR-seq variant that identifies silencers genome-wide by measuring the repressive activity of genomic fragments.

methods.name: STARR-seq
methods.title: Genome-wide quantitative enhancer activity maps identified by STARR-seq
methods.summary: Random genomic DNA fragments are placed in a reporter so that active enhancers transcribe themselves, and their activity is read out by sequencing the transcribed copies.

methods.name: Stereo-seq
methods.title: Spatiotemporal transcriptomic atlas of mouse organogenesis using DNA nanoball-patterned arrays
methods.summary: Spatial transcriptomics on DNA nanoball-patterned arrays with in situ RNA capture, reaching single-cell resolution.

methods.name: Stereo-seq V2
methods.title: Stereo-seq V2: Spatial mapping of total RNA on FFPE sections with high resolution
methods.summary: Stereo-seq variant that captures total RNA with random primers in situ on FFPE sections.

methods.name: StimDrop
methods.title: Microscale combinatorial stimulation of human myeloid cells reveals inflammatory priming by viral ligands
methods.summary: Antibody-based cell barcoding with droplet processing to formulate cell-population by stimulus combinations on a microfluidic device for single-cell RNA-seq.

methods.name: Stitch-seq
methods.title: Stitch-seq: Scalable CRISPR gene expression response profiling
methods.summary: Droplet-based overlap-extension RT-PCR that physically links targeted gene and protein expression to CRISPR perturbation identifiers in single cells, without cell barcoding.

methods.name: Strand-seq
methods.title: DNA template strand sequencing of single-cells maps genomic rearrangements at high resolution
methods.summary: BrdU-labels one parental DNA strand over a single replication round so each single cell's template strands are sequenced separately, mapping sister chromatid exchanges and inversions.

methods.name: STREAM
methods.title: Single-cell trajectories reconstruction, exploration and mapping of omics data with STREAM
methods.summary: Interactive toolkit that reconstructs and visualises single-cell differentiation trajectories from scRNA-seq and scATAC-seq data.

methods.name: Streamline CNV
methods.title: Streamline CNV - A Handy Nextflow Pipeline for Chromosomal Copy Number Variation Analysis
methods.summary: Nextflow/Docker pipeline for low-pass WGS copy-number analysis, from QC and CNV calling to segmentation, clustering and plots.

methods.name: STRT-seq
methods.title: Characterization of the single-cell transcriptional landscape by highly multiplex RNA-seq
methods.summary: Single-cell tagged reverse transcription that barcodes cDNA at the mRNA 5' end, so cells are pooled and sequenced by their 5' ends.

methods.name: STRT-seq-2i
methods.title: STRT-seq-2i: dual-index 5' single cell and nucleus RNA-seq on an addressable microwell array
methods.summary: STRT-seq on an addressable 9600-microwell array, with dual-index barcodes and cell sampling by limiting dilution or FACS.

methods.name: Sturgeon V2
methods.title: Sturgeon V2: a clinically applicable CNS tumor classifier trained on relabeled data
methods.summary: Locally executable CNS tumour classifier for sparse nanopore methylation profiles, retrained on relabeled public reference data with a redesigned architecture.

methods.name: SURGE
methods.title: SURGE: uncovering context-specific genetic-regulation of gene expression from single-cell RNA sequencing using latent-factor models
methods.summary: Unsupervised latent-factor discovery of context-specific eQTLs from single-cell transcriptomic data.

methods.name: Swap-seq
methods.title: Systematic mapping of enhancers, silencers, and topological elements with prime editing deletion screens
methods.summary: Pooled twin prime-editing deletion screen with flow sorting that measures how endogenous regulatory elements change expression of a nearby gene.

methods.name: T-Scan
methods.title: T-Scan: A Genome-wide Method for the Systematic Discovery of T Cell Epitopes
methods.summary: Lentiviral antigen libraries are expressed in target cells, T-cell-recognised cells are sorted with a granzyme B reporter, and the antigens are identified by sequencing.

methods.name: T2G
methods.title: T2G: fast and accurate transcriptome to genome BAM liftover for short and long read RNA sequencing
methods.summary: Converts complete BAM files from transcriptome to genome coordinates while keeping CIGAR strings, tags and RNA modification calls.

methods.name: TACTIC
methods.title: TACTIC: hybrid denoising and clustering for robust 16S amplicon diversity estimates
methods.summary: 16S rRNA amplicon analysis tool offering hybrid post-denoising clustering strategies (Taxonomy-Informed and Taxonomy-Agnostic Clustering) to reduce within-species splitting of zOTUs.

methods.name: TAP-seq
methods.title: Targeted Perturb-seq enables genome-scale genetic screens in single cells
methods.summary: Single-cell RNA-seq coverage focused on genes of interest, so CRISPR perturbation effects are detected with far fewer sequencing reads.

methods.name: TAPS
methods.title: Bisulfite-free direct detection of 5-methylcytosine and 5-hydroxymethylcytosine at base resolution
methods.summary: Bisulfite-free base-resolution detection of 5mC and 5hmC; TET oxidation plus pyridine borane reduction converts modified cytosines so they read as T, leaving unmodified C and DNA integrity intact.

methods.name: TARGET-seq
methods.title: Unravelling Intratumoral Heterogeneity through High-Sensitivity Single-Cell Mutational Analysis and Parallel RNA Sequencing
methods.summary: Single-cell targeted mutation detection from genomic and coding DNA, paired with whole-transcriptome RNA-seq from the same cell.

methods.name: TEA-seq
methods.title: Simultaneous trimodal single-cell measurement of transcripts, epitopes, and chromatin accessibility using TEA-seq
methods.summary: Droplet-based trimodal assay that measures RNA, surface epitopes and chromatin accessibility from the same single cells.

methods.name: TERRA
methods.title: Multi-scale modeling of human tissues from spatial transcriptomics with TERRA
methods.summary: Spatial transcriptomics foundation model pretrained on over 100 million human cells to learn transferable tissue-organisation representations.

methods.name: Tiled-C
methods.title: Dynamics of the 4D genome during in vivo lineage specification and differentiation
methods.summary: Low-input chromosome conformation capture (3C) technique for chromatin architecture at high resolution during in vivo differentiation.

methods.name: Tiled-MCC
methods.title: Analysis of sub-kilobase chromatin topology reveals nano-scale regulatory interactions with variable dependence on cohesin and CTCF
methods.summary: Micro-Capture-C with oligos tiled across a whole region, giving all-vs-all contacts within the captured locus.

methods.name: TIME-seq
methods.title: TIME-seq reduces time and cost of DNA methylation measurement for epigenetic clock construction
methods.summary: Highly multiplexed tagmentation-based targeted methylation sequencing used to build low-cost epigenetic clocks.

methods.name: TimeLapse-seq
methods.title: TimeLapse-seq: adding a temporal dimension to RNA sequencing through nucleoside recoding
methods.summary: Bulk RNA-seq that chemically recodes 4-thiouridine into cytidine analogs so newly transcribed RNA is marked by U-to-C mutations.

methods.name: TimeVault
methods.title: A genetically encoded device for transcriptome storage in mammalian cells
methods.summary: Genetically encoded vault particles capture polyadenylated mRNA inside living cells to store a transcriptome snapshot for later readout.

methods.name: TIP-seq
methods.title: High-throughput single-cell epigenomic profiling by targeted insertion of promoters (TIP-seq)
methods.summary: Antibody-tethered Tn5 inserts a T7 promoter at target sites; in vitro transcription amplifies them linearly for single-cell chromatin profiling.

methods.name: TOPmentation
methods.title: MLL-AF4 cooperates with PAF1 and FACT to drive high-density enhancer interactions in leukemia
methods.summary: Optimised high-throughput ChIPmentation for weakly bound non-histone proteins from ~100,000 cells. Named only in the Results section.

methods.name: Torino
methods.title: Reference-free isoform discovery links unannotated RNA processing to disease risk
methods.summary: Non-negative matrix factorization of read coverage across samples to find annotation-free RNA processing patterns such as intron retention.

methods.name: Trac-looping
methods.title: Trac-looping measures genome structure and chromatin accessibility
methods.summary: Transposase inserts a bivalent linker between interacting regions, capturing chromatin contacts and accessibility without fragmentation or ligation.

methods.name: Tri-C
methods.title: Single-allele chromatin interactions identify regulatory hubs in dynamic compartmentalized domains
methods.summary: 3C approach that captures concurrent chromatin interactions among multiple elements on individual alleles and within single cells.

methods.name: TwinC
methods.title: Prediction and functional interpretation of inter-chromosomal genome architecture from DNA sequence with TwinC
methods.summary: Interpretable convolutional neural network that predicts trans (inter-chromosomal) contacts from DNA sequence.

methods.name: txci-ATAC-seq
methods.title: txci-ATAC-seq: a massive-scale single-cell technique to profile chromatin accessibility
methods.summary: Tn5 pre-indexing of nuclei across samples followed by 10x barcoding, scaling scATAC to about 200,000 nuclei per reaction.

methods.name: VASA-seq
methods.full_name: Vast transcriptome analysis of single cells by dA-tailing
methods.title: High-throughput total RNA sequencing in single cells using VASA-seq
methods.summary: Total-RNA single-cell sequencing that fragments and tails all RNA after lysis, so non-polyadenylated and non-coding transcripts are captured.

methods.name: VirScan
methods.title: Viral immunology. Comprehensive serological profiling of human populations using a synthetic human virome
methods.summary: Immunoprecipitates antibodies from serum against a phage library displaying all human viral peptides and reads the bound clones by DNA sequencing.

methods.name: Virtual microfluidics
methods.title: Virtual microfluidics for digital quantification and single-cell sequencing
methods.summary: Cells are embedded in a thin hydrogel that slows diffusion enough to keep each cell's amplified genome in its own local cluster, giving single-cell whole-genome amplification and sequencing without droplets, wells or chips.

methods.name: VISION
methods.title: Functional interpretation of single cell similarity maps
methods.summary: Annotates sources of variation in single-cell RNA-seq data directly on the cell-cell similarity manifold and produces an interactive web report.

methods.name: wellDA-seq
methods.title: Single cell genome and epigenome co-profiling reveals hardwiring and plasticity in breast cancer
methods.summary: Dual-Tn5 tagmentation splits open and closed chromatin into ATAC and DNA libraries, with nanowell chip partitioning to co-profile copy number and accessibility in single cells.

methods.name: WGBS
methods.title: Human DNA methylomes at base resolution show widespread epigenomic differences
methods.summary: Bisulfite conversion plus whole-genome sequencing to map DNA methylation at single-base resolution.

methods.name: X-SPEAR
methods.title: X-SPEAR: An Extensible Framework for Spatial Panel Evaluation and Refinement
methods.summary: Framework that selects targeted spatial transcriptomics gene panels with DART Boolean gene rules trained on detection-aware reference data, plus probe-level off-target assessment.

methods.name: XplainTDA
methods.title: XplainTDA: Explaining the topological structure of single-cell multi-omics data through perturbation
methods.summary: Explainable topological data analysis framework that uses perturbation to identify the molecular determinants of persistent-homology structure in single-cell data.

methods.name: XYZeq
methods.title: XYZeq: Spatially resolved single-cell RNA sequencing reveals expression heterogeneity in the tumor microenvironment
methods.summary: Spatially barcoded single-cell RNA-seq workflow that encodes tissue-position metadata into scRNA-seq libraries.

methods.name: ZipSeq
methods.title: ZipSeq: barcoding for real-time mapping of single cell transcriptomes
methods.summary: Patterned illumination prints photocaged barcodes ("zipcodes") onto live cells in tissue, linking each transcriptome to its position.
